description: Share of Nepal that the HMA 8 m strips could add on top of the 8 m mosaic, from granule footprints in NASA CMR. A footprint is where a strip exists, not where it has valid pixels: stereo matching fails on cloud, snow and deep shadow, so the usable gain is smaller than the figure here. In the Bhote Koshi trial 24 of 26 strips passed the 5 m NMAD match and coverage went from 80.2% to 84.9%.
